summary.tldr: Creates a federal framework for sustainable jobs, with a council, action plans and regular reviews to support the shift to a net-zero economy.
what_it_does: Lets the Governor in Council name a minister, and other specified ministers, to carry out the Act.
Creates a Sustainable Jobs Partnership Council to give independent advice through social dialogue on measures for job creation and support for workers, communities and regions.
Requires a Sustainable Jobs Action Plan to be tabled in both Houses of Parliament every five years.
Creates a Sustainable Jobs Secretariat to help carry out the Act.
Requires a review of the Act within 10 years after it comes into force, and every 10 years after that.
summary.background: The bill was introduced in the House of Commons on 15 June 2023 and received first reading.
